mechanism.claim: A broad alt-perpetual basket that consistently leads the next BTC minute more than BTC leads the next basket minute identifies cross-asset price discovery flowing into BTC. During elevated BTC path variation, final-hour directional agreement should continue while that information transfer is absorbed.
mechanism.side: common strict sign of the final-hour median-alt cumulative return and BTC return
mechanism.why_distinct: HVABLR measures directional one-minute lead asymmetry between a fixed six-alt median return basket and BTC. Prior cross-alt work used contemporaneous return breadth, residuals, flow, turnover, ticket size, or variation dispersion; premium leadership used a BTC premium-index source rather than cross-asset price discovery.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: BTC completed six-hour variation strict-prior rank >=0.65
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: hourly false-to-true alt-to-BTC lead-asymmetry onsets are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.aligned_window: 360 exact aligned unique bars_binance interval=1m rows [D-6h,D) per symbol
features.source_valid: finite positive coherent OHLC for every symbol and timestamp; no duplicate, missing, nearest-time join, or imputation
features.alt_basket_return: cross-sectional median of the six alt minute returns at each of the 360 timestamps
features.leadership_advantage: alt_leads_btc minus btc_leads_alt; both variances strict positive
features.leadership_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 2,160 valid hourly decisions, minimum 1,440, current excluded; rank>=0.80
features.btc_variation: sum squared BTC minute returns over the same completed six hours
features.final_hour_returns: sum of the final 60 BTC returns and sum of the final 60 median-alt basket returns
features.direction_confirmation: both final-hour returns share one strict nonzero sign
features.eligible_state: leadership, BTC variation, and direction-confirmation gates pass
features.onset: eligible now and immediately preceding exact source-valid hour ineligible

clock.decision: D after all seven completed paths are available
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal-time entry
clock.funding: not an input; exact realized funding only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, and final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent fixed-basket cross-asset lead-lag price discovery

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no universe, window, basket, lag, correlation, rank, onset, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or gate repair
